reason: My article clerks rotate every couple of years, and I cannot spend precious billable hours training new batches on yet another software portal. In an ordinary week, if a tool requires onboarding effort, my staff will just revert to WhatsApp and the subscription will sit unused.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time.
would_change_my_mind: A zero-learning-curve interface where a new article clerk can handle maker-checker reviews on day one without any formal training.
